Where is grandma? One. Mary and John sometimes go shopping with grandma.
Hello, grandma. This is Mary. Hello, Mary. Do you want to go shopping
with John and me this Saturday? Yes. We can meet at the bus stop at 12
o'clock.
Two. Today is Saturday. Mary and John go to the bus stop. But grandma
is not there. Where's grandma? It's 12 o'clock. Grandma is never late.
Three. Grandma is cooking lunch in the kitchen. Where's Coco? Four.
Coco runs to the bus stop. She takes Mary and John to grandma's home.
Look. That's Coco. Hello, Mary. Hello, John. Come with me.
